text: How many H2020 projects does CORDIS classify with a nature of crisis response, and when did the earliest of them start?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(startDate) AS earliest_start FROM project WHERE nature = 'crisisResponse'
reference_answer: CORDIS tags 90 H2020 projects with a nature of crisisResponse - its crisis-response category, one of three undocumented values alongside crisisPreparedness and crisisRecovery. The earliest of these 90 started on 2020-02-13.
notes: Value-grounded on project.nature: schema_docs states the column is null in 34,814 rows and otherwise holds crisisPreparedness|crisisRecovery|crisisResponse, explicitly flagged as 'values not in codebook' - the exact camelCase literal 'crisisResponse' cannot be guessed from the natural-language question.

text: Among ERC-funded Horizon 2020 projects, what is the average project duration in months for each ERC grant type - Starting (ERC-STG), Consolidator (ERC-COG), Advanced (ERC-ADG), and Proof of Concept (ERC-POC)?
gold_sql: SELECT fundingScheme, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF('month', startDate, endDate)), 2) AS avg_months FROM project WHERE fundingScheme IN ('ERC-STG', 'ERC-COG', 'ERC-ADG', 'ERC-POC') GROUP BY fundingScheme ORDER BY fundingScheme
reference_answer: ERC Proof of Concept (ERC-POC) projects run much shorter than the three main ERC grant types: ERC-POC averages 17.96 months, while ERC-ADG averages 67.46 months, ERC-COG averages 68.02 months, and ERC-STG averages 67.48 months.
notes: FIX (judge ruling, sql-s15, AMBIGUOUS-READING, UPHELD/HIGH): question text now names each fundingScheme code explicitly in parentheses so 'Proof of Concept' cannot be defensibly read to include the distinct ERC-POC-LS (lump-sum) code. gold_sql and reference_answer are unchanged (option a).

text: How many Horizon 2020 projects have at least one participating organization based in Italy?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT projectID) AS project_count FROM organization WHERE country = 'IT'
reference_answer: 7,899 projects have at least one organization based in Italy (IT).
notes: Grain trap: organization is one row per project-organization participation (178,932 rows), so COUNT(*) after filtering country='IT' counts participations, not projects. Wrong query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization WHERE country='IT' -> 17243. Gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT projectID) ... -> 7899.
